exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter again and complete the table. Then, look at your notes and talk about Tony. Start like this: Tony Philips is seventeen years old. ...
exercises.instructionUz: Xatni qayta o'qing va jadvalni to'ldiring. So'ng qaydlaringizga qarab Toni haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL SARLAVHALARI — odam haqida gapirishning STANDART tartibi:

  FULL NAME       — to'liq ism
  AGE/OCCUPATION  — yosh va kasb
  CITY/COUNTRY    — shahar va mamlakat
  APPEARANCE      — tashqi ko'rinish
  FAMILY MEMBERS  — oila a'zolari
  HOME            — uy
  LIKES/LOVES     — nimani yoqtiradi

Shu tartibda o'zingiz haqingizda ham gapira olasiz.

Kitob berilgan boshlanish: 'Tony Philips is seventeen years old. ...'

structure.modelEn: His full name is Tony Philips.
Tony Philips is seventeen years old and he is a student.
structure.noteUz: Kitob shu gap bilan boshlashni taklif qiladi.

structure.modelEn: He is tall and slim with short dark hair and brown eyes.
There are seven people in his family. His grandparents are Steve and Sally.
His parents are Joe, a surgeon, and Kate, a teacher.
He has got a sister, Liz, aged nine, and a brother, Leo, aged six.
He lives at 43, St Catherine Street, in a big house about twenty minutes from the city centre.
He loves playing computer games and listening to rock music.
He also likes going to the cinema and he goes there every Saturday.
He doesn't like going to the theatre, though.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in niece, grandmother, wife, sister, daughter or aunt, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: niece, grandmother, wife, sister, daughter yoki aunt — birini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
ERKAK ↔ AYOL qarindoshlik juftliklari.

Har bir erkak qarindoshning ayol jufti bor:
  husband     ↔ wife         (er ↔ xotin)
  son         ↔ daughter     (o'g'il ↔ qiz)
  uncle       ↔ aunt         (amaki/tog'a ↔ amma/xola)
  nephew      ↔ niece        (jiyan o'g'il ↔ jiyan qiz)
  brother     ↔ sister       (aka/uka ↔ opa/singil)
  grandfather ↔ grandmother  (bobo ↔ buvi)
  father      ↔ mother
  grandson    ↔ granddaughter

O'ZBEK TILI BILAN FARQ:
O'zbekchada amaki (otaning akasi) va tog'a (onaning akasi)
farqlanadi. Inglizchada IKKALASI ham 'uncle'.
Shunday: amma va xola — ikkalasi 'aunt'.

TALAFFUZ QIYIN so'zlar:
  niece  /niːs/    — 'niis' (nayes EMAS)
  nephew /ˈnefjuː/ — 'NEF-yu'
  aunt   /ɑːnt/    — 'aant' (Britaniyada)

items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. er ↔ xotin. Ko'pligi: wives.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing days of the week, then listen and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Hafta kunlarining tushib qolganini yozing, so'ng tinglab takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAFTA KUNLARI — Britaniyada hafta DUSHANBADAN boshlanadi.

  1 Monday    — dushanba
  2 Tuesday   — seshanba
  3 Wednesday — chorshanba
  4 Thursday  — payshanba
  5 Friday    — juma
  6 Saturday  — shanba
  7 Sunday    — yakshanba

MUHIM QOIDA — hafta kunlari HAR DOIM KATTA HARF bilan:
  ✅ Monday   ❌ monday
Bu o'zbek tilida yo'q qoida, shuning uchun ko'p unutiladi.

QISQARTMALAR: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun

TALAFFUZ TUZOQLARI:
  Wednesday /ˈwenzdeɪ/ — 'WENZ-dey'. O'rtadagi 'd' O'QILMAYDI!
  Tuesday   /ˈtjuːzdeɪ/ — 'TYUUZ-dey'
  Thursday  /ˈθɜːzdeɪ/  — 'THOOZ-dey', til tishlar orasida

KUNLAR BILAN PREDLOG — ON:
  on Monday — dushanba kuni
  on Saturdays — har shanba (ko'plikda = har hafta)

items.whyUz: seshanba. Ro'yxatda berilgan uch so'zdan biri.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the free-time activities to the pictures. Not all the activities match the pictures.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlarini rasmlarga moslang. Barcha mashg'ulotlar rasmga to'g'ri kelmaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
MASHG'ULOTLAR RO'YXATI (12 ta):
  a) listening to (rock/classical/pop/jazz) music — musiqa tinglash
  b) walking in the park — bog'da sayr qilish
  c) going on a picnic — piknikka borish
  d) going to the cinema — kinoga borish
  e) travelling — sayohat qilish
  f) exercising — mashq qilish, sport
  g) reading — kitob o'qish
  h) fishing — baliq ovlash
  i) playing football — futbol o'ynash
  j) camping — chodirda dam olish
  k) playing the guitar — gitara chalish
  l) watching TV — televizor ko'rish

RASMLAR FAQAT 9 TA — demak UCHTA mashg'ulot rasmsiz qoladi.
Mashq nomi shuni aytadi: 'Not all the activities match the pictures.'

DIQQAT — 'the' qoidasi:
  play THE guitar / THE piano  (musiqa asbobi — 'the' SHART)
  play football / tennis       (sport — 'the' YO'Q)

exercises.instructionEn: Use the list of activities above and the verbs below to make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Yuqoridagi mashg'ulotlar ro'yxati va quyidagi fe'llar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT DARAJALI YOQTIRISH SHKALASI:

  love (♥♥)      — juda yaxshi ko'raman
  like (♥)       — yoqtiraman
  don't like (✗) — yoqtirmayman
  hate (✗✗)      — yomon ko'raman

QOIDA: bu fe'llardan keyin ikkinchi fe'l -ING oladi:
  I love reading.        (I love read EMAS)
  I don't like camping.  (I don't like camp EMAS)

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA — ikki xil bog'lash usuli:
  1) I like fishing and I love reading. I don't like camping THOUGH.
     ('though' alohida gapning oxirida)
  2) I like fishing and I love reading, BUT I don't like camping.
     ('but' ikki gapni bog'laydi, oldidan vergul)

Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri va bir xil ma'noni beradi.

rule.explanationUz:
Ingliz tilida egalik APOSTROF bilan ko'rsatiladi.
O'zbekchadagi '-ning' qo'shimchasiga o'xshaydi, lekin joyi teskari:

  o'zbekcha: bola-NING to'pi
  inglizcha: the BOY'S ball

DIQQAT — tartib TESKARI:
  the boy's ball = bolaning to'pi
  EGA birinchi, NARSA keyin. O'zbekchada ham shunday, lekin
  'ning' o'rniga apostrof va 's' ishlatiladi.

APOSTROF QAYERGA QO'YILADI — bu butun qoidaning MAG'ZI:
  ot BIRLIK bo'lsa      → 's   (the boy's)
  ot KO'PLIK va -s bilan tugasa → s'   (the girls')

TALAFFUZDA FARQI YO'Q: 'boys' va 'boy's' va 'boys'' —
uchalasi bir xil eshitiladi. Faqat YOZUVDA farqlanadi.

rules.enRule: We add 's when a noun is singular to show possession.

rules.uzRule: Ot KO'PLIK va -s bilan tugasa — faqat apostrof (') qo'shiladi.
rules.enRule: We add ' when a noun is plural and ends in -s to show possession.

rules.uzRule: Ikki (yoki undan ko'p) egasi bo'lsa — 's FAQAT OXIRGISIGA qo'shiladi.
rules.enRule: We add 's to the last noun of a phrase to show possession.
examples: This is Ann and John's mother.

rule.warningUz:
ENG KO'P XATO — apostrofni unutish yoki noto'g'ri joyga qo'yish:

  ❌ my sons bicycle    ✅ my son's bicycle     (bitta o'g'il)
  ❌ the boys bicycles  ✅ the boys' bicycles   (bir nechta bola)
  ❌ Jenny desk         ✅ Jenny's desk
  ❌ Tony's and Pam's house  ✅ Tony and Pam's house (bitta uy, ikki egasi)

DIQQAT: 'Tony's and Pam's houses' — bu BOSHQA ma'no:
Toninining uyi va Pamning uyi (ikkita alohida uy).
rule.noteUz:
KO'PLIK -s siz bo'lsa, 's qo'shiladi:
  children → the children's room  (bolalar xonasi)
  men      → the men's room
  women    → the women's team
  people   → the people's choice

Chunki bu so'zlar -s bilan tugamaydi.
rule.extraUz:
's QACHON ISHLATILADI:
  ✅ ODAM va hayvon uchun: Tony's book, the dog's tail
  ✅ vaqt uchun: today's newspaper, a week's holiday
  ✅ mamlakat/shahar uchun: Canada's cities

JONSIZ narsalar uchun odatda 'of' ishlatiladi:
  ✅ the door OF the house (uyning eshigi)
  ⚠️ the house's door — grammatik to'g'ri, lekin tabiiy emas

Va yodda tuting: it's ≠ its
  it's = it is (u ...dir)
  its  = uning (egalik, apostrof YO'Q!)

exercises.instructionEn: Read the examples and study the rules, then underline the correct items in the sentences below.
exercises.instructionUz: Namunalar va qoidalarni o'rganing, so'ng quyidagi gaplarda to'g'ri variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir gapda IKKI SAVOL bering:
  1) Ega BITTAMI yoki KO'PMI?
  2) Apostrof kerakmi?

Egalik bor bo'lsa — apostrof SHART.
Ega bitta bo'lsa 's, ko'p bo'lsa (va -s bilan tugasa) s'.

items.whyUz: Bitta o'g'il (birlik) → 's. 'sons' — apostrofsiz, u shunchaki ko'plik (o'g'illar).
Ism ham birlik ot — egalik uchun 's shart.
Ikki egasi, BITTA uy → 's faqat OXIRGI ismga qo'shiladi.
Ko'plik va -s bilan tugaydi → faqat apostrof: boys'.

exercises.explanationUz:
Qoidani mustahkamlash uchun qo'shimcha mashq.
Har birida ot birlikmi-ko'plikmi ekaniga qarang.

items.whyUz: Birlik → 's. Tartib teskari bo'ladi: ega + narsa.

items.textEn: the mother of Ann and John →
items.whyUz: Ikki egasi, bitta ona → 's oxirgi ismga.

groups.explanationUz: Ingliz tilida ko'p qarindoshlik so'zlari juft bo'lib keladi. Juftlik bilan yodlash osonroq.
Kun nomlari qadimgi xudolar va sayyoralar nomidan kelib chiqqan. Hammasi KATTA HARF bilan yoziladi.
Fe'lga -ing qo'shilsa, u 'shu ishni qilish' ma'nosini beradi va otdek ishlatiladi.
Apostrof joyi ot birlikmi-ko'plikmi ekaniga bog'liq.
Eng kuchlidan eng kuchsizgacha to'rt daraja.

patterns.exampleEn: This is the boy's ball. This is Jenny's desk.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu bolaning to'pi. Bu Jennining stoli.
patterns.explanationUz: Birlik ot bilan 's. Ega birinchi, narsa keyin.
Ko'plik -s bilan tugasa, faqat apostrof qo'shiladi.

patterns.formula: ISM and ISM's + narsa (bitta narsa, ikki egasi).
patterns.exampleEn: This is Ann and John's mother.
patterns.explanationUz: 's faqat OXIRGI ismga. Ikkalasiga qo'ysangiz — ikkita alohida ona degani bo'ladi.

patterns.formula: I love / like / don't like / hate + fe'l-ING.
patterns.exampleEn: I like fishing and I love reading. I don't like camping though.
patterns.exampleUz: Baliq ovlashni yoqtiraman va kitob o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman. Chodirda dam olishni esa yoqtirmayman.
patterns.explanationUz: Bu to'rt fe'ldan keyin ikkinchi fe'l DOIM -ING oladi.

patterns.exampleEn: I like fishing and I love reading, but I don't like camping.
patterns.exampleUz: Baliq ovlashni yoqtiraman va kitob o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman, lekin chodirda dam olishni yoqtirmayman.
patterns.explanationUz: 'but' bilan qarama-qarshi fikr. Vergul 'but' dan OLDIN qo'yiladi.

patterns.exampleEn: I go to the cinema on Saturday. / I play football on Mondays.
patterns.exampleUz: Shanba kuni kinoga boraman. / Dushanba kunlari futbol o'ynayman.
patterns.explanationUz: Kun bilan ON. Ko'plikda (on Mondays) — 'har dushanba' degani.
